faq.q: Can I make a TikTok ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, describe the product moment in one sentence and choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: What length can a TikTok ad be?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. A short clip can show one action; a longer clip gives a demo more room to finish.

faq.q: Do I need to book a TikTok creator or studio?
faq.a: No. Start from your own product photo, so there is no creator booking, studio day or footage queue.

faq.q: Does the download include music or captions?
faq.a: No. Add sound, captions and your offer in TikTok, CapCut or Ads Manager after download.

faq.q: Can I send the file straight to TikTok Ads Manager?
faq.a: Download the file first, then upload it yourself in TikTok Ads Manager or the TikTok app.

faq.q: What photo should I upload for a TikTok ad?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product and leaves a little space around it for TikTok controls and captions.

faq.q: Can I make another version from the same photo?
faq.a: Yes. Run another job with a different opening or product moment without arranging another shoot.

faq.q: When should I add TikTok AI-content labels?
faq.a: Follow TikTok's current AI-content and ad-review prompts in Ads Manager for the market where you will run the ad.
